Name: One Day at a Time
Author: miome
Description:
Do you tend to get caught up in playing and spend way longer than you meant to do?  One Day at a Time forces the game to exit after the end of an in-game day!  Great for encouraging yourself to get up and move around, take breaks, and possibly even go to bed??  Anything is possible!

The source code is available in [url=http://github.com/miome/OneDayAtATime]github[/url].  I give blanket permission for anyone to download and modify as long as there is a credit statement linking back to my github.  ﻿

[size=3][b]FAQ
[/b][/size]
[i]Can you set it to more than one in-game day?   [/i]I didn't build in support for user configuration, but there is a setting in the code to change it.  For anyone who wants to start programming in C# and making Stardew Mods, that would be an excellent first project!

[i]Instead of exiting, can I get a warning message?  [/i]Consider using [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8727]Exit After Save[/url] or [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8194]Weekly Break Reminder[/url] instead.
